title: Social Networking Event, London, March 6, 2012
html:
Several folks involved in Kamailio SIP Server and VoIP in general (including Daniel-Constantin Mierla, co-founder Kamailio) are organizing a social networking event in London, during the evening of 6th of March.

If you want to participate, send us a short note via registration form:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/w/registration-form/

Be sure your email is valid in order to send you the details of the location.

The event will be dinner/pub-drinks style, with the goal of discussing the latest developments of Kamailio project as well as what is new in VoIP and Unified Communications world. Participation is free, each person paying for his/her drinks and food.
